warning_text: GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) According to the Surgeon General, women should not drink alcoholic beverages during pregnancy because of the risk of birth defects. (2) Consumption of alcoholic beverages impairs your ability to drive a car or operate machinery, and may cause health problems.
notes: One flat can wrap, so there is a single image covering the whole can.
The brand carries a diacritic: the first letter is S with a caron, 'ŠVYTURYS', inside a black oval with '1784' below it. It is printed the same way on the bottom band.

'EKSTRA' is the largest text on the label. It is set in capitals 89 rows tall across the front panel, well above the oval's ŠVYTURYS, and again as a single word running 563 pixels down the side panel. The side panel's information block opens 'ŠVYTURYS EKSTRA' on one line. The reading above is the oval mark, which is in the brand position and is repeated on the bottom band; EKSTRA is the beer's own name and is the other candidate.

The front panel states the alcohol as '5.2% ALC./VOL.' with no space around the slash; the side information panel states it as 'BEER - 5.2% ALC./VOL.' with an en dash after BEER. The reading above is the front panel's.

Net contents appears once, in the side panel. The space between 'FL.' and 'OZ.' was measured on the pixels rather than judged by eye: it is 3 columns of blank, which matches the narrowest confirmed word space on the same line ('/' to '568' and '568' to 'mL' are both 3) and is wider than every gap inside a token (1 to 2). So it is a space, and the wording is 'FL. OZ.'
The full stop after mL is printed faintly - about grey 165 where the background is 210 and the letter strokes are 88 to 138 - but it is present, three columns past the foot of the L.
Warning is in the side panel, body in sentence case wrapped over narrow lines; the heading 'GOVERNMENT WARNING:' is bold capitals.
